subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI server-side tools be hidden whenever the active model provider is missing or not `xai`, or should unknown-provider contexts keep a maintainer-approved opt-in path?
rationale: This PR changes a credential-backed provider/billing boundary and can intentionally remove tools from existing unknown-provider contexts, so automation should not decide the permanent compatibility policy alone.

options.title: Fail closed by active provider
options.body: Accept the PR's direction after adding factory tests and real current-head proof that xAI tools appear only for xAI active-model runs.

options.title: Preserve unknown-provider use with opt-in
options.body: Require an explicit config or allowlist for unknown-provider contexts before hiding existing credential-enabled xAI tool behavior by default.

options.title: Defer to broader billed-tool policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define one cross-provider policy for provider-billed tools, opt-in, and billing visibility.

recommendation.title: Fail closed by active provider
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's direction after adding factory tests and real current-head proof that xAI tools appear only for xAI active-model runs.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current-main history ties both active-model context and committed xAI tool/auth changes to this owner path.
